title: Product Spotlight
slide_intent: Give a featured item enough context to suggest how someone might enjoy or use it, while keeping its packaging legible.
strategic_value: Instacart can feature a sponsor within the same photographic world as the food and lifestyle images.
demonstration: Packaged products appear among tomatoes, bread, drinks and other groceries. The brief extends the lighting guidance to occasions that need plain backgrounds.
practical_value: Choose a setting, props and light that preserve the product as the focal point. When a plain backdrop is required, carry the same lighting treatment into it.

content_islands.name: Sponsor brief
content_islands.spec: Use a dark left column for the title and the two shooting conditions. Anchor the four descriptive words at the bottom.

content_islands.name: Product settings
content_islands.spec: Assemble the bright photographs into a close right-hand mosaic. Show packaging amid related food and reserve a broad lower panel for the product on the tiled-counter set.
